description: This is a Kotlin test source file containing unit tests for the TaskViewModel class in an Android project. It uses mocking and coroutine testing frameworks to verify the behavior of task-related operations such as loading, adding, updating, toggling completion, and deleting tasks.

classes.name: TaskViewModelTest
classes.description: A test class for TaskViewModel verifying task loading, addition, update, toggle, and deletion functionalities with coroutine test support.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, including setting the main dispatcher and initializing the mock repository.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets the main dispatcher after tests.

methods.name: init_loads_tasks
methods.description: Tests that TaskViewModel loads initial tasks correctly on initialization.

methods.name: addTask_with_blank_title_sets_error_and_does_not_call_repo
methods.description: Verifies that adding a task with a blank title sets an error and does not call the repository.

methods.name: add_update_toggle_delete_calls_repository_and_updates_state
methods.description: Verifies adding, updating, toggling, and deleting tasks updates the repository and ViewModel state correctly.

methods.name: update_with_blank_title_sets_error
methods.description: Ensures that updating a task with a blank title sets an error and does not call update on the repository.
